summary: The Drawing (Document) Register, the Project QR Code and Sheet Images are completely absent from ValeVision: 33 TV files / 10,263 lines in LE/51__Feature__DrawingRegister, LE/53__Feature__ProjectQrCode and LE/54__Feature__SheetImages, plus the TV-only title block QR cell (479 lines) and the TV local-server blueprint NAAPPS/ProjectVision__TrueVisionSheetImages__Api__.py (478 lines). VV records this as deliberate (parity ledger rows 86/121/125/126/220/321-339; VV devlog v2.60.0 and v2.61.0), pending Adam's decision on whether VV gets a register (ledger row 339). The folder numbers 51/53/54 are free in VV's LE, so all three should land at identical paths, keeping every cross-module import from the title block, shape painter, Statement Writer and Parametric Scrapbook verbatim. The real work is the foundation: a mechanical import check of the 33 files finds 58 external named imports, 32 already resolving in VV and 26 not, grouped as (a) TV v2.71.0's three-part Document ID schema (GetPhase/GetDocumentId/ComposeDocumentId/Na__LeRec__DocumentId/GetDrawingRegisterSetup), (b) sheet-model and autosave register hooks, (c) TV transport modules (80__CloudflareIntegration ApiClient, LocalProjectMirror) that VV must answer with its own whitecardopedia-editor-api worker and Flask, (d) the save-step contract (Save(toast, report, registerKeys), RegisterSaveStep), (e) TV identity helpers (VV uses ?project= plus its master index), (f) TV-only editor systems (28 ObjectSnap, PickUpMove, WithAdoption, RegisterShapeProvider), (g) PdfFonts and (h) 31 DocumentKeys / 65 Publishing / 66 Sharing. Three VV data facts need Adam: VV project codes are not unique (13 of 152 shared by schemes/variants), a Vale-hosted QR address reaches only a version 4 symbol (0.270 mm module vs TV's 0.28 floor; the Vale Lantern Designer's live t/ resolver is the precedent), and VV's local mirror has just three projects with sheets and no stored drawing numbers, so adopting the register now is nearly free. Two TV defects were found to fix first: the register PDF never boxes a yellow revision warning (Notes stores 'yellow', the PDF boxes only 'red'/'amber'), and header gaps (DeleteDialog and all 15 SheetImages JS files lack PORT NOTE). Eight work packages are proposed: Document ID schema, register transport and save contract, register port and wiring, QR port with title block hooks, the VV QR resolver, VV sheet-image transport (Flask blueprint + worker routes), Sheet Images port with editor hooks, and ledgers/back-ports; twelve decisions are listed.

findings.title: Three TV-only LE feature folders have no VV counterpart; land them at identical numbers
findings.detail: TV LE/51__Feature__DrawingRegister (10 files, 3,659 lines), LE/53__Feature__ProjectQrCode (6, 1,895) and LE/54__Feature__SheetImages (17, 4,709) do not exist in VV. VV's LE uses 01,03,05,07,10,15,20,25,30,35,40,50,55,56,57,60,70,80, so 51, 53 and 54 are free. Other TV modules reach these by relative path (TitleBlock QrCell, ShapeGeometry, SheetChrome, ModeController, Statement Writer, Parametric Scrapbook), so identical paths keep those imports verbatim.
findings.recommendation: Create the three folders at the same LE-relative paths in VV with no renumbering; reserve VV LE 52 for 52__Feature__StatementWriter.
findings.evidence: drift_all.tsv: 33 tv-only rows for these folders; VV LE folder listing (no 51/53/54); TV consumers e.g. TitleBlock__QrCell__.js:95, ShapeGeometry__.js:123-126, SheetChrome__.js:193-194.

findings.title: VV project codes are not unique per folder: affects {project} in Document IDs and QR resolver keys
findings.detail: VV master index (152 entries) has 13 codes shared by schemes/variants, e.g. 63592 Bressard-Kayode and __Scheme-02, 63578 Yates__Orangery and __Porch, 62104 with three Fenner schemes; codes are 4-5 digits. TV AutoSave ignores 'register-updated' (:176) and exports Suspend/Resume/DiscardSavedDraft (:620-640, not logged in its DEVELOPMENT LOG). findings.title: Register persistence must run on VV's own worker and Flask: facade plus the 3-argument save contract
findings.detail: Register files import TV's 80__CloudflareIntegration ApiClient and 03__AppUtils/LocalProjectMirror (both absent in VV, and VV must keep its own worker). Needs: register block as loaded, fresh R2 read, key-merge save, local merge, local read; and VV Na__DrawData__Save(showToast, report, registerKeys) with cloud/local/localFirst keys, report.cloudSaved/local/localKeys/localFirstWritten/steps.
